theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_dql_c1Holder_of_tendstoUniformlyOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (ι : Type) (l : Filter ι), l.NeBot → ∀ (F : ι → Rn n → Rn ℓ) (G : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (x₀ : Rn n) (ρ α M : ℝ), 0 < α → (∀ᶠ i in l, ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) x) → (∀ᶠ i in l, ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ (F i) x‖ ≤ M) → (∀ᶠ i in l, ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ (F i) x - fderiv ℝ (F i) y‖ ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ ball x₀ ρ → TendstoUniformlyOn F G l K) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G (ball x₀ ρ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ G x‖ ≤ M) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ G x - fderiv ℝ G y‖ ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
